## PR 本文 (原文復旧 — devin-de2d106e)

## Summary

REV44-HEALTHSYNC — rev43-producers finding 7: the system-health chain (baseline → plan → run → assessments) and the AV-sync chain (condition → measurement) shipped complete domain models, repositories, and consumers but had ZERO production producers — `save_baseline`/`save_plan`/`save_run`/`save_condition`/`save_measurement` were dead writers, the 概要 稼働状況 domain could never leave 未チェック, and `health_baseline_created`/`health_check_completed`/`av_sync_recorded` activity kinds never fired.

This adds the honest minimal record-entry surfaces and wires the consumed side. New module `measurement_record_surfaces.py` hosts two dialogs on the measurement workspace 品質 context (where `AV_SYNC_CONDITION` already routes):

**健全性チェックの記録** (`HealthCheckDialog`, 3 tabs):
- ベースライン: name + optional persisted operating-preset pick + user-authored metric pins (ドメイン/メトリクスキー/単位 dB|Hz|m|単位なし/期待値/許容差 → typed reprs like `{"value_db":82.0}`; nothing is fabricated). Pin 証拠 is either a real persisted authority pick (measurement/prediction/scene revision/preset/variant with exact semantic hashes) or an explicitly declared `operator_entry` provenance ref — declared-only, never canonical.
- チェック計画: user-authored check items pinned to the baseline's own pins (`related_pin_ids`), `build_health_check_plan` + `save_plan`.
- チェック実行: per-check observation = persisted-authority evidence pick (or explicit skip), per-related-pin observed values mapped to `{pin_id: {unit_key: value}}`, repeatability flag, trigger → `run_health_check` + `save_run` + `verify_persisted_run`. Results show JA state labels (ベースライン内/変化あり/判定不能/比較不可/未実行).

**AV同期の記録** (`AVSyncRecordDialog`):
- Condition: scene/operating-state/variant pins auto-derived from current document state (current head revision + content hash; latest operating state; variant pick defaulting to the head-based variant) — registration fails closed when no scene head exists. Playback-chain fields user-entered (source/display devices, paths, modes, refresh/frame Hz, lip-sync ms).
- Measurement chain: first record is the `measured` head; each subsequent record pins the current head via `advance_av_latency_measurement` — the UI only offers 次の段階 (e.g. 次の段階: 補正要求 → 設定適用 → 残差検証) with stage-gated fields. Starting a new parallel chain is an explicit combo choice, never the default.

**Wiring**: quality page ends with AV同期/健全性チェック summary cards (条件 N件 · 測定 M件 / ベースライン N件 · 最新: 状態) refreshed on every `refresh()`; `OverviewSecondaryDomain.action` = 「チェックを記録」 deeplinking to 測定→品質 on both checked and unchecked branches; `TARGET_KIND_ROUTES` gives `HEALTH_BASELINE`/`HEALTH_CHECK_PLAN` real routes; measurement `focus_target` resolves these record kinds + `AV_SYNC_CONDITION` fail-closed (ghost ids → `focused=False`). Activity events fire with no new consumer code — `_health_events`/`_av_sync_events` were already pure row projections, so real saves now emit `health_baseline_created`/`health_check_completed`/`av_sync_recorded`.

Intentionally manual: pin authoring stays user-entered (no auto-derive-from-measurement synthesis — deriving pins from REW data would fabricate baselines); `operator_entry` evidence is honest provenance, not authority; unknown playback fields stay `'unknown'`.
